dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: I run an antique store, and I am the most reliable antique appraisal expert in Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: My grandfather was a well-renowned historian. The gift of antique appreciation runs in our family.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: You can definitely trust my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Be it the relics of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, or the accessories of the Goddess of Flowers, or even what King Deshret left amidst the desert, there is not a single thing that I cannot tell the authenticity of at first glance.
